entities.summary: Yulia Sergeevna Shoigu is a Russian psychologist who is the current director of the Center of Emergency Psychological Aid of the Ministry of Emergency Situations. She was appointed in 2002 and is concurrently the vice-president of the Russian Psychological Society. She is the eldest daughter of Sergei Shoigu.
